CustomField.description: Who, which event, level, amount and paid status in one line (e.g. Bob Smith · 2027 Gala · Advocate · $15,000 · Unpaid), so pickers and lookups show something more useful than the EVR number. Created 2026-11-06 by Jason Ott.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Contact__c)), TRIM(Contact__r.FirstName & " " & Contact__r.LastName), IF(ISBLANK(Donor_First_Name__c) && ISBLANK(Donor_Last_Name__c), "No donor", TRIM(Donor_First_Name__c & " " & Donor_Last_Name__c))) & " · " & Event__r.Name & IF(ISBLANK(Sponsorship_Level__c), "", " · " & Sponsorship_Level__c) & IF(ISBLANK(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c), "", " · $" & IF(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c / 1000000)) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(MOD(FLOOR(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c / 1000), 1000)), 3) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(MOD(FLOOR(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c), 1000)), 3), IF(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(MOD(FLOOR(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c), 1000)), 3), TEXT(FLOOR(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c)))) & IF(MOD(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c, 1) = 0, "", "." & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(Sponsorship_Donation_Amount__c, 1) * 100, 0)), 2))) & IF(Paid__c, " · Paid", " · Unpaid")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Donor · Event · Level · Amount · Paid status
CustomField.label: Registration Summary
